messages:
nora_mkt: Short heads-up — fresh draft of the product launch post is up: https://docs.example.com/launch-brand-voice. Need signoff on tone, benchmark language, routing for inbound leads, and JP/PT-BR short CTAs. Would like to lock by EOD tomorrow. :memo:

jared_growth: I'll own CTAs + A/B variations. Recommend intent x region split: webinar-first vs quickstart; track with rl_brand.variant and rl_brand.cta GA events.

suki_pm: Benchmark source: internal bench-v4 on A100s. Current line says "30% faster" — prefer clarity: "~30% lower p99 latency in our tests" and include a short methodology block.

claire_legal: Please avoid the word "faster" without context. Legal-safe phrasing: "Based on internal benchmark v4 comparing Redwood runtime to OpenModelX on identical hardware. Methodology: 3,000 requests; mixed seq lengths; p99 measured across 5 runs." Remove superlatives like "unmatched" or "industry-leading."

paul_ops: Ops notes for routing/playbook: mapping = {"NA":"sales-na","EU":"sales-eu","APAC":"partners-apac","LATAM":"sales-latam"}. Webinar capacity: EU-friendly slots Wed/Fri 11am CET, 45 seats; auto-waitlist after 45. Also add UTM `?utm_source=blog&utm_campaign=brand_launch&utm_variant=A|B`.

content-bot: Reminder: draft freeze in 14 hours for scheduling.

nora_mkt: Thanks — pasting the methodology block into the draft now. Also proposing we soften any ROI language: replace "guaranteed cost savings" -> "projected cost reductions" per legal.

jared_growth: CTA copy variants (<=50 chars):
- Variant W (webinar-first): "Join the launch webinar" -> tags: `lead:webinar`, `route:region-based`
- Variant Q (quickstart-first): "Open the quickstart & deploy" -> tags: `lead:docs`, `route:docs-flow`
PT-BR short: Variant W = "Participe do webinar de lançamento" (will trim if too long)
JP short: Variant W = "ローンチウェビナーに参加する" (<=50 chars)

suki_pm: Pushing small benchmark edit: "~30% lower p99 latency (internal tests)." Also adding citation line: "See methodology in appendix." Is that okay, legal?

claire_legal: Fine if you inline the methodology; appendix link is fine as long as it is accessible. Also change "projected" -> "estimated" for cost phrasing.

paul_ops: For inbound routing snippet in ops playbook, include this sample mapping and code:
```python
region_map = {
  "NA": "sales-na",
  "EU": "sales-eu",
  "APAC": "partners-apac",
  "LATAM": "sales-latam"
}
# auto-waitlist at capacity=45
```
And for registration flow please append utm params.

nora_mkt: I've updated the draft with legal's wording, ops mapping, and CTA variants. Link: https://docs.example.com/launch-brand-voice#v3. Asking for final thumbs by EOD tomorrow.

jared_growth: I'll prepare the A/B test config: 50/50 traffic, 2-week run, primary metric = demo signups / quickstart starts. Will add experiment tags to the doc.

suki_pm: Tiny nit: change "identical hardware" to "identical hardware configurations" for clarity. Then I'm happy.

claire_legal: Acceptable. One last nit: replace parentheses around methodology with an em-dash or separate sentence. Otherwise legal sign-off.

nora_mkt: Done — moved methodology to its own paragraph and swapped "projected" -> "estimated" per Claire. Final draft link: https://docs.example.com/launch-brand-voice#v4. If no objections by EOD, I'll lock copy and hand to ops for scheduling. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
